List counts are the constructed 60s currently on that source. Tournament lists live on event pages ([[List of SWCCG tournaments]], [[Championships]]); the count is event lists whose titles carry a year and Light or Dark. A list posted both to an event page and to a fan catalog can appear in both rows.

[[Fan sites]] indexes the independent websites. [[DeckTech tournament reports]] name pairings and finishes and sometimes a 60.

== History ==

In 2007 the [[Players Committee]] began posting the decklists of all of that year's qualifier events in a forum thread, "2007 Qualifier Event Decklists", in its Event Decklists board; the first post said this was a big part of posting all decklists and also let the design team look them over where needed.<ref name="sf-14543-201849">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=201849#p201849 2007 Qualifier Event Decklists], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (14 March 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126083109/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=14543 Internet Archive]</ref> The scanned lists were posted one event at a time, from the [[2007 Match Play Championship|Match Play Championship]] and [[2007 Endor Regionals|Endor Regionals]] on 1 April 2007<ref name="sf-14543-205094">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=205094#p205094 2007 Qualifier Event Decklists], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (1 April 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126083109/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=14543 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-14543-205095">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=205095#p205095 2007 Qualifier Event Decklists], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (1 April 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126083109/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=14543 Internet Archive]</ref> to the California State Championship on 2 August 2007.<ref name="sf-14543-221945">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=221945#p221945 2007 Qualifier Event Decklists], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (2 August 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126083109/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=14543 Internet Archive]</ref> On 18 July 2007 the PC wrote that this was the first year of the program, that it had not always run "100%", and that it was working with tournament directors so that all future qualifier lists would be handed in.<ref name="sf-14543-218508">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=218508#p218508 2007 Qualifier Event Decklists], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 July 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126083109/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=14543 Internet Archive]</ref> Scanned PDFs posted in that thread for Italy States, Norwegian Nationals, Hungary States, Ralltiir Regionals and European Championships were not preserved; see [[Mysteries#Score sheets, decks and listings that were not preserved]].

== How lists are arranged ==

* '''Tournament tables:''' Date, Format, Event, Finish, Player, Dark, Light. Event is the event page. Dark and Light are the constructed lists; pipe text is the Objective 0-side or starting site.
* '''General tables:''' Date, Format, Title, Side, Author, Source. Title is the list. Source is the published post.
